summary: Match Group filed an 8-K reporting its Q1 2026 results and declaring a $0.20/share cash dividend payable July 21, 2026 to holders of record July 7, 2026. The filing includes a press release and prepared remarks with financial performance details. The dividend declaration is a routine capital return event, not a special situation. The registrant is acting as the issuer of its own stock. No M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spinoff, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or deal termination is involved. The dividend is a regular quarterly payout per standard practice. Watch for ongoing operational trends at Tinder and Hinge, but no special-situation arbitrage angle exists.
